news.title: Keralam sets two year deadline for setting up logistics parks
news.para: Keralam has rolled out a new framework for logistics parks, requiring developers to show substantial progress within a two-year timeline. These guidelines apply equally to private projects and public-private partnerships, ensuring each initiative is backed by a strong implementation strategy. A single-window clearance board will facilitate quicker approvals, while investment subsidies will be available based on project milestones, provided the chosen areas avoid ecologically sensitive zones or existing parks.

news.title: Gurugram civic body approves construction debris collection up to 500 tonnes daily
news.para: Gurugram's Municipal Corporation has taken a positive step by approving a budget specifically for enhancing door-to-door construction waste collection and sanitation services. Key projects sanctioned by the Finance and Contract Committee include increasing workforce and machinery dedicated to sanitation. With a focus on improving waste management systems, the corporation aims to minimize debris in public areas, demonstrating its commitment to robust sanitation services throughout all municipal zones.

news.title: House tax defaulters in Varanasi warned of assets attachment after November 15
news.para: The Varanasi Municipal Corporation has delivered a final ultimatum to building owners regarding overdue house taxes. A special one-time settlement initiative allows defaulters to evade surcharges by signing up before November 15. Despite being available for over a month and a half, few have taken advantage of this offer.

news.title: RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% as per market expectations as inflation risks strengthen
news.para: The Reserve Bank of India has raised its policy repo rate by 25 basis points in response to growing inflation concerns. This marks a notable change from its earlier policy of lower rates. With inflation in India expected to surpass 5 percent due to various economic dynamics, the rupee is currently trading at 96.36 per US dollar. This decision signals potential upcoming changes in monetary policy and impacts economic growth.

news.title: Illegal buildings thrive in Cyberabad despite crackdown
news.para: Recent building collapses in Hyderabad raise alarming concerns about unauthorized construction in the city. The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation is stepping up efforts to combat illegal building activity, especially on smaller plots. In the past six months alone, over 1,000 complaints related to unauthorized structures have been recorded. Experts advocate for stricter penalties against offenders, suggesting that current measures, such as partial demolitions, are insufficient.

news.title: Thiruvananthapuram's Technopark invites bids to operate GCC launchpad
news.para: Technopark is calling for proposals from managed-office operators for its exciting new Keralam GCC Launchpad. This innovative facility is designed to accommodate global enterprises looking to set up in Keralam, offering fully serviced office spaces. Operators can enjoy a rent-free period for the first six months. Proposals need to be submitted by October 31, ahead of a pre-bid meeting on October 13.

news.title: Manesar civic body's commissioner orders closure of all unauthorised RMC plants within 15 days
news.para: MCM commissioner Pradeep Singh has set forth a directive for officials to finalize road construction within established timelines and close down any unauthorized concrete plants. Stressing the critical need to combat dust emissions for better air quality in Gurgaon, he mandated the monitoring of construction sites for safety and cleanliness protocols.

news.title: Hilton signs agreements for two hotels in Bengaluru with Kalyani Group, adds 600 rooms
news.para: Hilton has forged a partnership with Kalyani Group to introduce two new hotels in Bengaluru, adding 600 rooms to their portfolio. These properties will be branded as Conrad Hotels & Resorts and Hilton Hotels & Resorts and are set to launch in 2030, conveniently located close to Kempegowda International Airport.

news.title: Embassy REIT to acquire 8,048 sq ft office space in Mumbai’s BKC for ₹48.29 crore
news.para: Embassy Office Parks REIT will acquire a commercial unit in First International Financial Centre, Bandra Kurla Complex, from Citigroup Global Markets India for ₹48.29 crore. The acquisition, comprising 8,048 sq ft of saleable area, is expected to be completed by Q3 FY27.

news.title: Canada's CPP Investments get CCI not to acquire stake in Prestige Hospitality
news.para: In a significant move, Canada's CPP Investments has received the green light from the Competition Commission of India (CCI) to purchase a 27% stake in Prestige Hospitality Ventures for around 441 million Canadian dollars. This represents CPP's inaugural step into India's hospitality scene, augmenting its presence in the Asia Pacific market. Prestige manages a collection of luxury hotels across key Indian cities.

news.title: JSW Cement commissions one MTPA grinding unit at Nagaur; total capacity rises to 25.1 MTPA
news.para: JSW Cement has commissioned an additional 1 MTPA cement grinding unit at its Nagaur plant in Rajasthan, taking the facility’s grinding capacity to 3.5 MTPA and the company’s total grinding capacity to 25.1 MTPA.

news.title: Spain approves 21 urgent housing measures after protests ahead of snap election
news.para: Spain's government has approved a package of urgent measures aimed at addressing the ongoing housing crisis. After violent protests erupted in Barcelona, Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez highlighted the need for immediate action. The approved measures include extending eviction protections and regulating housing rentals. An interim legislature will need to ratify the decrees as Sanchez prepares for early elections. Rising housing costs have marginalized many Spaniards despite overall economic growth.

news.title: Delhi civic body seeks ₹60 crore annual grant to curb illegal construction in colonies, cites fund crunch
news.para: To address the growing issue of illegal construction in Delhi, the Municipal Corporation is seeking Rs 60 crore in funding. This financial injection will facilitate drone surveillance and the formation of 21 enforcement squads to cover 12 distinct zones. Additionally, the corporation plans to execute meticulous three-dimensional drone surveys every three months.

news.title: Experion Developers plans ₹10,000 crore investment in five years
news.para: Experion Developers plans to invest around ₹10,000 crore, including land, approvals and construction, to deliver approximately 3,000 luxury and ultra-luxury homes and plots over the next five years. Around two-thirds of the proposed pipeline will be located in NCR.

news.title: Gurugram plot owners take DTCP ‘jurisdiction’ question to Supreme Court
news.para: A group of plot owners has approached the Supreme Court against a recent High Court ruling. This ruling permits the town and country planning department to address building violations in licensed colonies. The petitioners argue that municipal jurisdiction applies to these areas based on historical precedents. They contend that the department's authority should be limited by municipal boundaries.

news.title: Enforcement directorate attaches 88 acres of land linked to Anand Jain’s Jai Corp
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has seized major land parcels in Alibaug during a money laundering probe linked to Jai Corp Ltd, headed by Anand Jain. The firm is accused of mishandling a venture capital fund, failing to reimburse investors after the fund's term ended. Investigations suggest the land was undervalued, leading to criminal proceeds of Rs 230 crore.

news.title: NBCC floats tenders worth ₹9,620 crore  for completion of 16 stalled Supertech projects
news.para: NBCC has floated 25 tenders aggregating ₹9,620.33 crore for construction and related works across 16 stalled Supertech projects comprising nearly 50,000 housing units. The projects are spread across Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Uttarakhand and Karnataka.

news.title: Max Estates pre-sales rise to ₹3,200 crore in H1 FY27
news.para: Max Estates reported pre-sales of about ₹3,200 crore in H1 FY27, including ₹2,100 crore in the September quarter. The company has a development pipeline with potential GDV of over ₹29,000 crore and plans major launches in Noida and Gurugram during H2 FY27.

news.title: Vishal Dadlani sells commercial unit in Mumbai for ₹3.34 crore
news.para: Singer and music composer Vishal Dadlani has sold a 641 sq ft commercial unit in Goregaon West, Mumbai, for ₹3.34 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards. He had purchased the property in 2016 for ₹3.25 crore.
